compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects occupy the central and lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to show full bodies from head to toe.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure standing/leaning slightly forward creates a focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large script in the top left, across the subjects' faces, to the serif text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space in the upper third of the frame accommodates the typography.
